Familiar-face recognition versus tasksequence example retains abilities and support stages without diagnosing lobe/disease. Dementia multiple causes and life/social impact, not one forgetting event or age-only dismissal; professional diagnosis/functionassessment and individualplan/facility guidance.

Age-related versus dementia forgetting comparison retains part versus whole event, course, awareness and dailyimpact; table tendencies not exceptionless. Awareness/anxiety do not exclude dementia and lack of awareness alone not diagnostic; pace varies by cause. Personhistory/familiar environment/remaining abilities/motivation respected; short clear words and response time, no convenience-only rearrangement. Sharedactivity/dayrhythm individualized, listenanxiety/consultsupport, no uniform activity. Acceptfeelings not confirm unverifiedevents; no arguing into admitting error/public memorytesting. Preservewords/checkfacts together as needed/report assignedperson, evaluation/plan/guidance retained.

Alzheimer atrophy/new-eventmemory difficulty/gradual changes distinct from vascular brainvascular damage/site-dependent abilities/stepwise possible/hemiplegia/aphasia.
